title: Legal Counsel - Litigation & Compliance
description:
**Company Description** 
 BrightCHAMPS is a fast\-growing edtech platform focused on bridging the gap between traditional education and the real\-world skills children need to thrive. The company offers expert\-designed courses in Coding, Financial Literacy, Math, Robotics, AI, Communication, and other future\-ready domains, serving learners in more than 30 countries. Backed by $63M in funding and valued at $650M, BrightCHAMPS delivers over 200,000 live classes each month and is recognized with multiple “Startup of the Year” and leadership awards. The organization fosters a collaborative, impact\-driven culture where educators and innovators work together to inspire young minds. BrightCHAMPS’ vision is to become the world’s most trusted education platform, making transformative learning accessible to every child, regardless of background.
 



  





**Role Overview** 





 The Senior Legal Counsel \& Compliance Manager serves as the primary legal advisor to the organisation, supporting business operations across India, Singapore, the United States, UAE, Vietnam, and other jurisdictions. The role oversees commercial contracts, litigation, regulatory compliance, employment law, data privacy, intellectual property, and strategic legal risk management, providing practical legal guidance that enables business growth.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Commercial Contracts** 





 Draft, review, negotiate, and manage commercial agreements, including customer, SaaS, vendor, partnership, consultancy, service, banking, and financing agreements.
 





 Maintain contract templates and negotiation playbooks.
 





 Advise business teams on contractual risks and commercial transactions.
 




  





**2\. Litigation \& Dispute Management** 





 Manage domestic and international disputes, including consumer, employment, TCPA, contractual, arbitration, and court matters by:
 





 Coordinating with external/foreign counsel.
 





 Managing litigation strategy, evidence, discovery, and legal research.
 





 Supporting settlement negotiations and ongoing case management.
 




  





**3\. Regulatory Compliance \& Data Privacy** 





 Ensure compliance with applicable laws across operating jurisdictions.
 





 Advise on data privacy, fintech regulations, and other legal compliance requirements.
 





 Monitor regulatory developments and update internal policies.
 




  





**4\. Employment Law** 





 Advise on employment matters, HR policies, investigations, and labour law compliance.
 




  





**5\. Intellectual Property** 





 Manage IP protection, licensing, enforcement, and related legal matters.
 




  





**6\. Legal Advisory** 





 Draft and respond to legal notices.
 





 Partner with business, product, HR, and finance teams to provide practical, risk\-balanced legal advice.
 





 Support strategic legal risk management and governance initiatives.
 




  





  





**Preferred Qualifications** 





 LL.B. / B.A. LL.B.
 





 5\+ years' post\-qualification experience in corporate legal and compliance.
 





 Experience handling cross\-border legal matters across jurisdictions such as India, Singapore, the US, UAE, and Vietnam is preferred

title: Principal Legal Counsel - Disputes
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016\. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life\-till\-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android\-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
   

  

 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 PhonePe is considering candidates for the position of Senior Manager for its Disputes \& Advisory. The role is an unique position that enables candidates to think and act independently to develop and implement the optimal legal strategies for the company in relation to its disputes as well as its policies and approach towards and under various laws. The candidate will be exposed to PhonePe’s wide range of businesses, each with their own unique areas and applicable laws that provide candidates with the necessary exposure to grow professionally as well as providing structured pathways for growth within the company.
   

  

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Represent the company before courts, law enforcement agencies and regulators as may be required.
* Vetting and review of all types of pleading/drafting.
* Develop and implement the optimal strategies for disputes that the company may encounter.
* Guide PhonePe’s various companies through compliance with their applicable laws and assist business in developing models that are compliant and / or minimize risk.
* Develop and prepare stakeholder comments to proposed bills with a focus on how the proposed regulations would impact the company’s businesses.
* Lead, train and guide subordinates in developing their skills and aid in their professional growth.
* Identify and coordinate with external legal counsel to carry out litigation on the company’s behalf across various jurisdictions.
* Should be well versed with Power Point and excel.


**Qualifications**
**Requisite Qualifications:**
* Educatio : LL.B/LL.M or higher from a recognized university and admission to a bar council in India.
* Experience : 10\-12 years prior experience in the legal industry with a minimum of atleast 8 years of litigation practice with a renowned law firm or practitioner.


**Preferred Qualifications and Requirements:**
* Location : The role is situated in Bellandur, Bangalore and the candidate is primarily required to work from office.
* Languages : English is mandatory. Candidates with written / spoken knowledge of Kannada would be preferred.


**Additional Information**

 Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. title: Legal Executive
description:
**Designation:** 
 Legal Executive
 



**Department** 
 : Legal
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Management / Senior Management
 



  





**Job Summary** 




  





 We are looking for a Legal Executive to support the organization in handling legal documentation, contract management, corporate and statutory compliance, legal research, and coordination with internal teams and external legal professionals. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring timely completion of legal activities and assisting in identifying and mitigating potential legal risks.
 



  





**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Legal Documentation \& Contract Management** 




 Draft, review, and vet agreements, contracts, notices, affidavits, undertakings, and other legal documents. Review contractual terms and highlight potential legal risks or concerns. Coordinate for execution, renewal, modification, and closure of agreements. Maintain proper records of all legal documents and agreements.
 



  





**2\. Corporate \& Legal Compliance** 




 Monitor corporate and legal compliance requirements applicable to the company. Ensure adherence to applicable laws, rules, regulations, and statutory requirements. Maintain compliance trackers and calendars and monitor important deadlines. Coordinate with relevant departments and external professionals for timely completion of compliance requirements.
 



  





**3\. Legal Research \& Support** 




 Conduct legal research on contractual, corporate, regulatory, and compliance\-related matters. Provide legal and documentation support to management and internal teams. Track relevant changes in laws and regulations that may impact the business. Assist in preparing legal opinions, responses, and supporting documentation as required.
 



  





**4\. Coordination \& External Liaison** 




 Coordinate with internal departments for agreements, legal documentation, approvals, and compliance matters. Liaise with advocates, legal consultants, government authorities, and other external stakeholders. Assist in handling legal notices, disputes, claims, and other ongoing legal matters. Ensure timely follow\-up and closure of pending legal matters.
 



  





**5\. Legal Records \& Risk Management** 




 Maintain and update legal records, agreements, notices, correspondence, and compliance documents. Monitor contract and compliance deadlines, renewals, and pending actions. Assist in identifying potential legal and contractual risks and recommend appropriate actions. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive legal and company information.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 




 Good knowledge of contract drafting, review, and legal documentation. Understanding of corporate and statutory compliance requirements. Strong legal research and analytical skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Attention to detail and strong documentation skills. Good coordination, follow\-up, and deadline\-management skills. Ability to handle confidential information professionally. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Word and Excel.
 



  





**Educational Qualification** 




 LLB / LLM from a recognized university. Candidates with relevant experience in corporate legal, contracts, or compliance will be preferred.
 



  





**Experience** 




 2–5 years of relevant experience in a corporate legal department, law firm, or similar organization. Experience in contract drafting/review, legal compliance, and coordination with advocates or external legal consultants will be an advantage.

title: Investor Relations & Company Secretary
description:
**Company Overview**
 Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as India’s no. 1 RPM Company.
   

  

 We are seeking visionary individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. As a part of our dynamic team, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with top healthcare providers in the country, applying AI\-powered RPM solutions to tackle some of the most pressing challenges in healthcare \- enhancing staff efficiency, improving patient outcomes, and pioneering the next generation of care models.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're looking for a sharp, self\-driven finance professional to own the execution layer of fundraising, investor relations, and corporate governance.
   

  

 You'll work in a fast\-paced environment, translating company performance into investor\-ready narratives, running live diligence processes, and keeping board and compliance machinery running clean.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who wants exposure to the full arc of a growth\-stage company's capital journey.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Fundraising**
* Build and maintain financial models, cap tables, and scenario analyses to support equity and debt/convertible fundraising
* Prepare pitch decks, information memoranda, and data rooms; manage due diligence workflows end\-to\-end
* Track deal timelines, coordinate across investors, legal counsel, and internal stakeholders, and keep the process organized under pressure
* Research and profile prospective investors; support outreach and relationship\-building


**Investor Relations**
* Produce board decks, MIS packs, and quarterly investor updates that tie operating metrics to financial narrative
* Manage the existing investor communication cadence — reporting, queries, ad hoc analyses
* Translate business KPIs (ARPU, unit economics, cohort performance) into clear, investor\-facing communications.


**Secretarial \& Governance**
* Coordinate board and committee meetings — scheduling, agenda, pre\-reads, minutes, and action tracking
* Manage the secretarial and compliance calendar in partnership with the external vendor and legal counsel (ROC filings, statutory registers, ESOP administration, cap table hygiene)
* Own document management for governance and investor records


**Required Skills**
* MBA (Finance) from a Tier 1/2 institute
* 1–2 years of experience in Investment Banking, or equivalent (corporate development, transaction advisory)
* Strong financial modeling and Excel skills; polished at building decks and investor materials
* Structured, detail\-obsessed, and comfortable managing multiple workstreams to deadline
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to distill complexity for a sophisticated audienc
* Exposure to health tech, SaaS, or medical devices (Good to have)
* Familiarity with Indian corporate governance and secretarial processes (Companies Act, ROC, ESOP)
* Understanding of US healthcare / RPM markets (Good to have)

 The Sr. Manager Trade Compliance is responsible for the trade operations and development of the strategies, policies, processes, and requirements for medical devices import, export, and trade programs. The responsibility also includes import and export classification, country of origin, trade preferential, supply chain security (C\-TPAT, AEO), export control / license determination, and other trade compliance programs. title: Company Secretary & Legal Executive
description:
Company Secretary \& Legal Executive
 
**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Experience:** 
 2–3 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| Work from Office
 



**Qualification:** 
 Qualified Company Secretary (CS) – Mandatory
 



**Industry:** 
 Interior Design / Project\-Based Business
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are looking for a qualified Company Secretary with around 2–4 years of relevant experience who can independently manage the company’s secretarial, legal, contractual, and regulatory compliance requirements.
 



 This will be a hands\-on role working closely with the Finance team, management, external consultants, and different business functions. The person should be comfortable handling statutory compliances as well as day\-to\-day legal documentation, agreement drafting, contract review, and compliance tracking.
 



 The role requires someone who can take ownership of matters from drafting and documentation through execution, filing, follow\-up, and closure.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesCompany Secretarial \& Companies Act Compliance
 * Manage day\-to\-day secretarial compliances under the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable rules.
* Prepare notices, agendas, resolutions, minutes, attendance records, and other documentation for Board Meetings and General Meetings.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, minutes books, and other mandatory corporate documents.
* Prepare and file applicable forms and returns with the Registrar of Companies and Ministry of Corporate Affairs within prescribed timelines.
* Track annual and event\-based statutory compliance requirements and ensure timely completion.
* Support changes relating to directors, authorised signatories, registered office, share capital, shareholding, and other corporate matters.
* Coordinate with practising Company Secretaries, Chartered Accountants, legal advisors, auditors, and other consultants wherever required.
* Maintain proper records of all statutory filings, challans, acknowledgements, approvals, and supporting documents.


 Legal Agreements \& Contract Management
 * Draft, review, revise, and maintain various commercial and legal agreements.
* Draft and review customer agreements for interior design and turnkey execution projects.
* Review commercial terms, payment clauses, scope of work, timelines, termination provisions, indemnities, liabilities, warranties, dispute resolution, confidentiality, and other contractual protections.
* Draft and review vendor agreements, service agreements, consultant agreements, channel partner agreements, Non\-Disclosure Agreements, Memorandums of Understanding, addendums, amendments, declarations, undertakings, and other business documents.
* Coordinate with internal teams before execution to ensure that commercial terms agreed with customers, vendors, and partners are properly reflected in contracts.
* Maintain a central agreement repository with executed copies, supporting documents, validity periods, renewal dates, and amendment history.
* Track agreement expiry, renewal, notice periods, obligations, and other critical contractual dates.


 Customer \& Business Documentation
 * Prepare and standardise customer agreement formats and supporting legal documentation.
* Review deviations requested by customers and highlight legal or commercial risks to management before acceptance.
* Ensure signed agreements and supporting documents are properly maintained and easily retrievable.
* Work with Sales, Finance, Design, Execution, Purchase, and other teams on documentation requirements.
* Support documentation relating to customer disputes, payment issues, contractual deviations, project delays, and other commercial matters.


 Legal \& Regulatory Compliance
 * Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar covering applicable corporate and business compliances.
* Monitor changes in applicable laws and regulations and communicate relevant requirements internally.
* Coordinate for licences, registrations, renewals, certificates, declarations, and statutory documentation applicable to the business.
* Assist in documentation and responses relating to legal notices, regulatory notices, disputes, claims, and other legal matters.
* Coordinate with external advocates and consultants for ongoing legal matters and maintain proper case\-wise documentation and status trackers.
* Support management in ensuring that company policies, agreements, and business practices remain legally compliant.


 Corporate Governance \& Documentation
 * Maintain proper corporate records and ensure documents are organised and audit\-ready.
* Support management with Board and shareholder\-related documentation.
* Prepare resolutions, authority letters, Power of Attorney documents, declarations, undertakings, and other corporate documentation as required.
* Assist with due diligence, audits, corporate restructuring, banking documentation, and other special assignments.
* Ensure proper documentation and compliance for changes in the company’s corporate structure or business operations.


 Compliance Tracking \& MIS
 * Maintain a master compliance tracker covering due dates, owners, status, supporting documents, and completion dates.
* Maintain an agreement tracker covering customers, vendors, partners, consultants, landlords, and other stakeholders.
* Provide periodic compliance and legal status updates to management.
* Highlight upcoming deadlines, pending documentation, contractual risks, and compliance gaps before they become overdue.
* Ensure that every compliance and legal matter is properly documented from initiation through closure.


 Candidate Requirements
 * Qualified Company Secretary and member of ICSI.
* Approximately 2–4 years of post\-qualification or relevant professional experience.
* Good practical knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, MCA filings, Board processes, statutory registers, and corporate governance requirements.
* Strong experience in drafting and reviewing commercial agreements and legal documents.
* Ability to understand commercial transactions and translate business requirements into appropriate contractual terms.
* Good drafting skills with strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable coordinating with senior management, internal departments, auditors, consultants, advocates, customers, and vendors.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently track matters until closure.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, document management, and compliance trackers.


 Preferred Experience
 
 Candidates with exposure to any of the following would be preferred:
 


* Interior design, construction, real estate, project\-based, or service businesses.
* Customer contracts and project execution agreements.
* Vendor and subcontractor agreements.
* Commercial disputes and legal notices.
* Corporate restructuring or conversion\-related compliances.
* Multi\-location business operations.
* Working closely with Finance and business teams rather than handling only routine secretarial filings.


 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who goes beyond simply filing forms and maintaining statutory records.
 


* The ideal candidate should be capable of independently understanding a business transaction, identifying the documentation and compliance requirements, drafting or reviewing the necessary agreement, coordinating with relevant stakeholders, tracking statutory and contractual timelines, and ensuring the matter is properly closed and documented.

title: Manager - Data Privacy Risk
description:
**About TerraPay**
 TerraPay is a leading global payments infrastructure company connecting banks, fintechs, digital wallets, money transfer operators, and businesses through a secure and scalable global payments network. Operating across 150\+ markets, TerraPay enables seamless cross\-border money movement through innovative payment solutions and robust financial infrastructure. As TerraPay continues to scale globally, we are looking for a highly driven Data Privacy Risk Manager to establish and lead our data privacy function.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly motivated Manager \- Data Privacy Risk who can establish, own, and mature TerraPay's data privacy framework. This role will operate as an Individual Contributor initially and will be responsible for driving privacy governance, regulatory compliance, privacy risk management, and stakeholder engagement across the organization.This is a unique opportunity to build the privacy function from the ground up in a fast\-growing global fintech environment.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Data Privacy Governance \& Compliance**
* Establish, maintain, and continuously enhance the organization's Data Privacy Management Framework
* Develop and implement privacy policies, procedures, standards, and governance controls
* Ensure compliance with GDPR, UK GDPR, India's DPDP Act, and other applicable global privacy regulations
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on business operations
* Maintain privacy documentation, governance records, and compliance evidence


**Privacy Risk Management**
* Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate privacy and data protection risks across the organization
* Conduct Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)
* Evaluate privacy risks associated with new products, services, technology implementations, and third\-party engagements
* Recommend practical risk mitigation strategies and oversee remediation efforts
* Develop privacy risk reporting and monitoring mechanisms for leadership review


**Data Protection Operations**
* Manage Data Subject Rights Requests (DSARs), ensuring timely and compliant responses
* Lead investigations involving privacy incidents and personal data breaches
* Coordinate root cause analysis, corrective actions, and regulatory reporting requirements where applicable
* Maintain Records of Processing Activities (ROPAs) and other privacy compliance artifacts


**Stakeholder Management \& Advisory**
* Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Information Security, Product, Technology, Operations, HR, and Business teams
* Act as a trusted advisor on privacy and data protection matters
* Provide clear, practical, and risk\-based guidance to internal stakeholders
* Build strong working relationships across functions to drive privacy initiatives effectively
* Support discussions with auditors, regulators, and external compliance stakeholders


**Privacy Awareness \& Training**
* Develop and deliver privacy awareness and training programs
* Promote a strong culture of privacy and responsible data handling
* Support ongoing education initiatives to improve organizational understanding of privacy obligations


**Program Development \& Continuous Improvement**
* Build and mature TerraPay's privacy operating model from the ground up
* Establish governance forums, reporting dashboards, and privacy metrics
* Champion privacy\-by\-design and privacy\-by\-default principles across business and technology initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement and transformation initiatives to strengthen privacy controls and governance


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Law, Compliance, Information Security, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline
* 5\-8 years of experience in Data Privacy, Data Protection, Privacy Risk Management, Information Governance, Compliance, or related functions
* Strong knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR, DPDP Act, and global privacy frameworks
* Experience conducting DPIAs, privacy risk assessments, compliance reviews, and governance activities
* Strong understanding of privacy risk management and regulatory compliance requirements
* Experience working within highly regulated industries such as fintech, payments, banking, financial services, or consulting
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills
* Ability to work independently and build a function from scratch
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, CDPSE, or equivalent
* Experience supporting privacy programs within fintech, banking, payments, investment banking, or consulting organizations
* Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, and external compliance stakeholders
* Familiarity with privacy management and governance platforms such as OneTrust, TrustArc, Archer, ServiceNow GRC, or similar tools
* Exposure to operational resilience, third\-party risk management, and information governance frameworks
* Experience operating within global and multi\-jurisdictional regulatory environments


**What Success Looks Like**
* Establishment of a scalable and sustainable Data Privacy Governance Framework
* Effective identification, assessment, and mitigation of privacy risks across the organization
* Strong compliance with applicable global privacy regulations
* Increased privacy awareness and accountability across business and technology functions
* Successful integration of privacy\-by\-design principles into products, services, and operational processes
* Trusted advisor status among senior leadership and key stakeholders
* Meaningful contribution to TerraPay's governance, risk management, and growth objectives.
* Experience implementing or operationalising privacy frameworks from inception is highly desirable


**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation package
* Opportunity to work with a truly global payments company operating across 150\+ markets
* Exposure to leading banks, fintechs, stablecoin issuers, and payment ecosystems worldwide
* 25 days annual leave plus public holidays and birthday leave
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits
* Career development opportunities within a fast\-growing global fintech organisation

 As an AI Risk Advisory SME, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding HSBC’s adoption of Generative AI technologies. * Risk Expertise: Demonstrated experience in multiple risk stripes \- model risk, data risk, cyber risk, technology risk, and operational resilience.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to critically assess complex AI solutions and articulate risk exposures and mitigations to technical and non\-technical audiences.

* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, concise reports and presentations for senior management.


**Desirable**

title: Family Law Paralegal — Entry Level
description:
***Role: Family Law Paralegal — Entry Level***




***Work Location: Bengaluru, On\-site***




***Timings: 5:30 pm. 2:30 a.m IST***




  





 Our client is looking for a
 **detail\-oriented, tech\-savvy Junior Paralegal** 
 to join their team and support attorneys handling divorce, custody, support, and related family law matters,
 



 This
 **training\-focused opportunity** 
  is ideal for someone early in their legal career. What matters most is your
 **attention to detail, strong written English, technology skills, organization, and ability to work with clients going through challenging situations.** 




  





**What you will do:** 



* Draft and assemble pleadings, motions, orders, and discovery using templates
* Prepare financial disclosures and organize supporting documentation
* E\-file documents and track deadlines, hearings, and service requirements
* Maintain case files, calendars, and client records
* Communicate with clients by phone, email, and in person
* Organize discovery and hearing exhibits
* Coordinate subpoenas, service of process, and records requests



**Minimum Qualifications** 



* Paralegal certificate, Associate's degree, or Bachelor's degree (any field). Relevant work experience may substitute.
* 0–2 years of legal or professional office experience. Internships and clerk positions count.
* Strong written English — you'll draft correspondence and pleadings from templates.
* Typing speed of 60\+ WPM with accuracy.
* Ability to pass a background check and maintain strict client confidentiality.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior exposure to family law, litigation, or any court\-facing role.
* Familiar with U.S. laws.
* Familiarity with Odyssey eFileNV or any court e\-filing system.
* Spanish fluency.



**Core Job Duties** 



* Draft and assemble pleadings, motions, orders, and discovery from firm templates.
* Prepare Financial Disclosure Forms and supporting exhibits; organize bank statements, pay records, and asset documentation.
* E\-file with the Eighth Judicial District Court and track filing deadlines, hearing dates, and service requirements.
* Maintain case files and calendars in our case management system.
* Communicate with clients on status updates, document requests, and scheduling — by phone, email, and in person.
* Organize and Bates\-stamp discovery productions and hearing exhibits.
* Coordinate service of process, subpoenas, and records requests.



**Technology Skills — Required** 




**This firm runs on technology, and they are looking for someone who's genuinely good with it.** 




**Microsoft Office** 



* **Word:** 
 Advanced. Styles, headers/footers, page numbering, track changes, comments, section breaks, tables, and mail merge. You should be able to fix a broken pleading caption without starting over.
* **Excel:** 
 Intermediate. Build and maintain asset/debt schedules, formulas, sorting and filtering, formatting for exhibits.
* **Outlook:** 
 Email management, rules, calendar coordination, meeting invites.



**Google Workspace** 



* Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail, and Calendar. Comfortable moving documents between Google and Microsoft formats without wrecking the formatting.



**AI Tools** 



* Working familiarity with AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) and real interest in using them well.
* Ability to write clear, specific prompts and iterate when the first output misses.
* Sound judgment about AI's limits: verifying every citation, fact, and calculation before it leaves your desk, and never entering confidential client information into unapproved tools.
* Willingness to learn our internal AI drafting workflows and suggest improvements to them.



**General Technology** 



* Adobe Acrobat: combining PDFs, OCR, Bates numbering, redaction, bookmarks, fillable forms.
* Legal case management software (MyCase, Clio, Smokeball, Filevine, or comparable) — experience with any one of these transfers.
* Video conferencing (Zoom, Teams) for remote hearings and client meetings.
* E\-signature platforms (DocuSign, Adobe Sign).
* Basic troubleshooting — you can solve a printer, scanner, or login problem without stopping your day.



**Personal Qualities** 



* **Detail\-oriented.** 
 In family law, a wrong date or a missing signature page has real consequences.
* **Organized under deadline pressure.** 
 Multiple cases, multiple courts, competing due dates.
* **Discreet.** 
 You'll handle financial records, medical information, and allegations that must stay confidential.
* **Composed and compassionate.** 
 Clients are often anxious, angry, or grieving. You need to be kind without absorbing it.
* **Self\-directed.** 
 You ask good questions, then run with the answer.
* **Coachable.** 
 You'll get feedback constantly in year one. That should energize you, not deflate you.



  





**Interested in applying?** 




 Please apply with your updated resume and tell us briefly about your relevant experience and why you’re interested in this opportunity.

title: Officer - Social Compliance
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**
- **Compliance Monitoring:**

* Monitor working conditions, employee well\-being, and factory environmental impact to ensure adherence to corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies.
* Ensure that the factory meets the requirements set by customers and international certifications for social compliance.


- **Audit and Reporting:**

* Prepare reports and documentation for social compliance audits.
* Follow up on non\-compliance issues and ensure corrective actions are taken in a timely manner.
* Coordinate and manage external audits by third\-party organizations and customers' compliance teams.


- **Training and Awareness:**

* Conduct training programs for factory management and workers on social compliance issues such as workers’ rights, health and safety, and environmental protection.
* Educate workers about their rights and provide mechanisms for them to report grievances safely.


- **Corrective Action Plans:**

* Work with management to develop and implement corrective action plans to address areas of non\-compliance.
* Ensure that improvements are implemented and followed up on regularly.


- **Grievance Management:**

* Establish and manage systems for workers to report grievances, ensuring that they are addressed in a timely and effective manner.
* Maintain open communication channels with workers and unions, if applicable.


- **Supplier Management:**

* Work with suppliers to ensure they meet social compliance standards and that the factory’s supply chain remains ethical and responsible.
* Perform supplier audits and follow up on corrective actions for any identified issues.


- **Legal and Ethical Compliance:**

* Stay updated on local and international labor laws, regulations, and ethical practices.
* Implement best practices for workplace ethics and ensure compliance with international labor standards such as the ILO (International Labor Organization) guidelines.


- **Health and Safety:**

* Oversee workplace health and safety standards, ensuring compliance with local laws and international standards.
* Conduct risk assessments, provide recommendations for improving workplace safety, and ensure workers are provided with the necessary protective equipment.


- **Reporting to Management:**

* Provide regular reports to senior management regarding social compliance issues, audits, and progress on corrective actions.
* Advise management on any changes in regulations or industry standards that may affect the factory’s operations.


**Working Conditions:**
* The Social Compliance Officer typically works on\-site at the garment factory and may need to travel to various supplier locations or attend external training sessions and audits.


 Requirements

title: Compliance Testing
description:
**About OnePay**
 OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.
   

  

 Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.
   

  

 We’re an all\-in\-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high\-yield savings, credit cards, point\-of\-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.
   

  

 We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category\-defining.
   

  

 But What Really Sets OnePay Apart Is How We Move. Our Customers Don’t Have Time To Wait… And Neither Do We. This Place Moves Fast, And We’re Looking For People Who Are
   

  

* Ready to run
* Hungry and driven by urgency
* Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
* Comfortable operating in motion


 The role
   

  

 As a Compliance Testing professional, you will help strengthen OnePay’s Compliance Testing Program by turning regulatory requirements and control objectives into clear, risk\-based testing. You will independently assess control effectiveness, identify consumer\-risk themes, and deliver evidence\-based conclusions that help the business move quickly and responsibly.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Compliance Controls, Product, Operations, Risk, Legal, Data, Engineering, and Marketing. Reporting to the Compliance Testing Lead, you will contribute to annual planning, testing execution, issue management, and concise reporting for senior stakeholders. This role is well suited for a high\-ownership operator who is comfortable working through ambiguity, building practical solutions, and raising the bar as OnePay scales.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Plan and execute risk\-based compliance testing across OnePay products, customer journeys, operational processes, marketing communications, servicing, complaints, and third\-party activities.
* Develop clear testing objectives, populations, procedures, evidence requirements, and conclusions that are reproducible, well\-supported, and aligned to the applicable regulatory requirement and control objective.
* Assess the design and operating effectiveness of preventive and detective controls; identify root causes, customer\-impact considerations, and practical opportunities to strengthen or automate controls.
* Perform data\-driven analysis by coordinating with stakeholders, validating source data, evaluating population completeness and accuracy, and documenting data limitations or exceptions.
* Evaluate compliance with applicable federal and state consumer\-financial requirements, including but not limited to UDAAP, ECOA/Regulation B, EFTA/Regulation E, TILA/Regulation Z, FCRA/Regulation V, GLBA/Regulation P, FDCPA, Regulation DD, FINRA, SEC requirements, and relevant state laws and regulations.
* Draft high\-quality workpapers, findings, observations, and management reports that clearly describe the requirement, condition, risk, customer impact, root cause, and recommended corrective action.
* Track remediation commitments, validate corrective\-action closure, and communicate emerging risks, control themes, and testing results to senior management and key business partners.
* Contribute to the annual Compliance Testing Plan and Compliance Risk Assessment by identifying regulatory changes, product changes, complaint trends, audit results, and other risk indicators.
* Maintain current knowledge of regulatory developments, enforcement trends, and industry practices relevant to OnePay’s products and operations.
* Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve the speed and quality of testing — including regulatory research, evidence analysis, workpaper drafting, issue spotting, and knowledge management while applying appropriate human review, data\-handling, confidentiality, and governance controls.
* Build lightweight, scalable testing methods, documentation standards, dashboards, and automation that help Compliance move fast, stay rigorous, and keep improving. Additional duties as assigned by your manager.


 You bring
   

  

* Professional fluency in written and spoken English.
* Five to ten years of experience in compliance testing, compliance monitoring, audit, or consulting within consumer financial services, fintech, banking, or a similarly regulated environment.
* Demonstrated experience executing regulatory or control reviews and translating regulatory requirements into practical, risk\-based test procedures.
* Working knowledge of U.S. consumer\-financial\-services regulations and the ability to research and apply federal and state requirements to products, processes, and customer communications.
* Strong analytical skills, including experience assessing data quality, defining test populations, investigating exceptions, and drawing balanced, evidence\-based conclusions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise, high\-impact reports for senior management and collaborate effectively across functions.
* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities while meeting deadlines.
* AI\-forward: hands\-on fluency with AI tooling and genuine interest in using it responsibly to improve testing velocity, analysis quality, and knowledge sharing without compromising confidentiality, accuracy, or professional judgment.
* An act\-like\-an\-owner mentality, intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward action. You are comfortable with ambiguity, low ego, and energized by solving meaningful problems alongside cross\-functional partners.
* CRCM, CIA, CISA, CAMS, or comparable certification — or active progress toward one — is a plus.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary, stock options, and benefits from Day 1
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage (health insurance, accident and disability insurance, term life insurance), including mental health support and wellness programs
* Hybrid work model (Bengaluru office three days a week), various time off programs (vacation, sick, other paid leaves, and paid regional holidays)
* Monthly transport and work\-from\-home allowances
* A high\-growth, mission\-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

* Interview with Talent Partner
* Technical or Hiring Manager Interview
* Team Interview
* Executive Interview
* Offer!

 To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real\-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **What You'll Do**
* Security Design: Developing and implementing SAP security, including role design, authorization objects, and user access controls across various SAP modules (S/4HANA, EWM, FMS CAR, Fiori, BW, ECC etc.).
* GRC Configuration \& Management: Configuring and managing SAP GRC modules, primarily Access Control (AC), Process Control (PC), and Risk Management, to automate security processes, manage risk assessments, and enforce compliance.

* Segregation of Duties (SoD) \& Risk Analysis: Performing SoD and critical access (CA) analysis, developing/refining the GRC ruleset, and working with business process owners to define and manage mitigating controls.
* Compliance \& Audit Support: Ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulations (e.g., SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, NIST, J\-SOX). This includes supporting internal and external auditors by providing evidence, running reports, and resolving audit issues.
* Incident Response \& Monitoring: Monitoring SAP systems for suspicious activity, investigating security incidents, identifying vulnerabilities, and implementing corrective actions.
* Collaboration \& Guidance: Acting as a technical lead, providing guidance to business stakeholders and other IT teams (Basis, development, functional analysts) on security issues and best practices.
* Documentation \& Training: Creating and maintaining technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and delivering security awareness training to users and internal teams.


**What You'll Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Accounting or related field is required.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience: Minimum of 8\-10\+ years of experience in SAP Security and GRC, with hands\-on experience in configuration and implementation across various SAP landscapes (on\-premise and cloud).

* Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of compliance frameworks and security auditing techniques.
* Problem\-Solving: Analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills to diagnose complex security and access issues.
* Communication: Communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical security concepts into business\-relevant language for non\-technical stakeholders.

 IT Users, Project Managers, Business users, VP and SVP
   

  

**External:** 
 Contract programmers, Consultants and third\-party Administrators.

title: Legal Counsel – Funds & Transactions
description:
About LVX
 



 LVX is one of India's leading Angel Network platforms for private market investing, connecting investors with high\-growth startups and managing investment vehicles across the early\-stage ecosystem. LVX is backed by Accel. With $200mn under management. 
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are looking for a Legal Counsel who will be at the centre of our fund and deal activity. You will own the legal lifecycle of our Category I and Category II Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), from structuring and SEBI registration through to ongoing compliance, and you will drive the documentation and negotiation of our startup investments, particularly term sheets and shareholders' agreements.
 



 This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working closely with investment teams, founders, and investors, and who can turn complex regulation into practical, commercially sensible advice.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Fund Formation \& AIF Regulatory
 



 Advise on the structuring, setup, and launch of Category I (including Angel Funds and Venture Capital Funds) and Category II AIFs, and new schemes under existing funds.
 



 Draft and review fund documentation, including Private Placement Memorandums (PPMs), trust deeds, contribution agreements, investment management agreements, and side letters.
 



 Manage SEBI registration applications, scheme launch filings, and correspondence with SEBI and the trustee.
 



 Ensure ongoing compliance with the SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012 and related master circulars, including periodic reporting, PPM audits, valuation, investor onboarding, and disclosure requirements.
 



 Track regulatory developments affecting AIFs and angel investing (including the accredited investor framework) and advise the business on their impact.
 



 Oversee KYC/AML and FEMA considerations for resident and non\-resident investors in the funds.
 



  





 Investment Transactions
 



 Draft, review, and negotiate term sheets, Shareholders' Agreements (SHAs), Share Subscription Agreements (SSAs), and related transaction documents for startup investments.
 



 Negotiate key investor protections, including board and observer rights, information rights, anti\-dilution, liquidation preference, pre\-emptive rights, ROFR/ROFO, tag\-along, drag\-along, and exit provisions.
 



 Work with instruments common in venture deals, such as equity, CCPS, CCDs, and convertible notes.
 



 Coordinate legal due diligence, review diligence reports, and manage conditions precedent and closing deliverables.
 



 Advise on Companies Act, 2013 and FEMA/NDI Rules requirements relevant to investments, including private placement, pricing, and reporting obligations.
 



 Support follow\-on rounds, secondary transactions, and exits for portfolio companies.
 



  





 Business \& Stakeholder Support
 



 Act as the go\-to legal advisor for investment, fund operations, and investor relations teams.
 



 Draft and review commercial contracts, platform terms, vendor agreements, and NDAs.
 



 Support data protection and platform compliance, including under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\.
 



 Manage and coordinate external counsel efficiently and cost\-effectively.
 



 Build templates, playbooks, and processes that help the legal function scale with deal volume.
 



 What We're Looking For
 



 Must\-Have
 



 LLB from a recognised university; enrolled with a State Bar Council.
 



 4–5 years of PQE at a reputed law firm and/or in\-house with a VC fund, PE fund, AIF manager, or investment platform.
 



 Hands\-on experience with Category I and Category II AIFs, including fund documentation and SEBI compliance.
 



 Strong track record of drafting and negotiating term sheets and SHAs in venture capital or private equity transactions.
 



 Solid working knowledge of the SEBI AIF Regulations, Companies Act, 2013, FEMA and NDI Rules, and the Indian Contract Act.
 



 Excellent drafting skills and attention to detail.
 



 Ability to manage multiple live deals and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 Clear, confident communicator who can explain legal risk in commercial terms to non\-lawyers.
 



 Good to Have
 



 Experience with GIFT City (IFSC) fund structures.
 



 Exposure to secondary transactions or fund\-level exits.
 



 Company Secretary (CS) qualification.
 



 Familiarity with the startup and angel investing ecosystem in India.
 



  





 Why Join LVX
 



 Work at the heart of India's startup investing ecosystem, with exposure to a high volume of deals and fund structures.
 



 High ownership and direct impact on how the platform and funds operate.
 



 Close collaboration with senior leadership and investment teams.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 Send your CV to natasha.jain@lvxventures.com with the subject line "Legal Counsel – Mumbai"

**Role:**

**Location:** 
 HSR Layout, Bangalore
 



**Experience:** 
 5–7 years
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 We are looking for a Compliance Manager to support and strengthen the regulatory compliance framework of our NBFC. The role will be responsible for monitoring regulatory requirements, implementing applicable RBI and other statutory guidelines, conducting compliance reviews, managing regulatory reporting, and supporting corporate governance and secretarial activities.
 



 The candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders, auditors, legal advisors, and senior management to ensure timely and effective compliance with applicable regulatory and statutory requirements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Regulatory Compliance** 



* Monitor compliance with applicable RBI, PMLA, FEMA, KYC/AML and other regulatory requirements.
* Track regulatory circulars, notifications and guidelines and assess their applicability to the business.
* Support implementation of regulatory changes within defined timelines.
* Maintain compliance trackers, MIS and periodic compliance reports.
* Provide compliance guidance to business and functional teams.
* Identify compliance gaps and coordinate with stakeholders for timely remediation.



**2\. Compliance Monitoring \& Risk Management** 



* Conduct periodic compliance reviews and testing across relevant functions.
* Identify potential areas of compliance risk and recommend appropriate controls.
* Support PMLA/KYC/AML compliance reviews and risk assessments.
* Monitor adherence to internal compliance policies, SOPs and regulatory requirements.
* Track and facilitate closure of internal, statutory and regulatory audit observations.



**3\. Regulatory Reporting** 



* Prepare and coordinate timely submission of applicable regulatory returns and reports.
* Maintain proper records and documentation for regulatory and audit requirements.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams and external advisors for regulatory submissions and clarifications.



**4\. Corporate Governance \& Secretarial Support** 



* Support compliance with the Companies Act and applicable Secretarial Standards.
* Assist in preparation and maintenance of Board/Committee meeting documentation, minutes and resolutions.
* Support maintenance of statutory registers, records and corporate filings.
* Coordinate with the Company Secretary, auditors and external legal advisors, as required.



**5\. Policies \& Process Improvement** 



* Assist in developing and updating compliance policies, SOPs and control frameworks.
* Ensure policies are aligned with regulatory changes and business requirements.
* Conduct compliance awareness and training sessions for employees, where required.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen and automate compliance monitoring and reporting processes.



**6\. Stakeholder Management** 



* Work closely with Business, Risk, Operations, Finance, Legal, Internal Audit and other functions on compliance matters.
* Coordinate with external consultants/legal counsel on specific regulatory matters.
* Escalate significant compliance issues and risks to the appropriate management stakeholders in a timely manner.



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 



* **5–7 years of experience** 
 in Compliance, Regulatory, Secretarial or related functions within an
 **NBFC, Bank, Fintech or Financial Services** 
 organization.
* Qualified
 **Company Secretary (CS)** 
 preferred; candidates with a relevant Law degree (LLB/LLM) will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of
 **RBI regulations, PMLA, KYC/AML, FEMA and Companies Act** 
 .
* Experience in regulatory compliance monitoring, reporting, audits and compliance testing.
* Good understanding of corporate governance and statutory compliance requirements.
* Strong analytical, documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple stakeholders and meet regulatory timelines.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail and ownership.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling fintech/NBFC environment.
* Exposure to regulatory compliance, governance and risk management.
* Opportunity to build and strengthen scalable compliance processes.
* High visibility and cross\-functional interaction with senior stakeholders.

title: Trust Architect
description:
**Summary**
 Trust Architects build trust in the AI and trust among the people who use it. They make sure every system Avanade Next ships is safe, reliable and ready for production — and that the client's people are confident, capable and willing to adopt new ways of working alongside it.
   

  

 The role operates across two dimensions. Trust in the AI: evaluation frameworks, accuracy measures, security controls, governance controls and human\-in\-the\-loop safeguards. Trust in the people: adoption design, capability uplift, ways of working and confidence in human\-agent collaboration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Building trust in the AI**
* Design and run evaluations: define accuracy targets, build the harness, drive the system to target and evidence it.
* Set governance, risk and security guardrails before build begins, and keep them current as the system evolves.
* Embed guardrails, controls and human\-in\-the\-loop review, including the feedback loop that improves the system after release.
* Establish the evidence required for a system to move from prototype to production, and hold the release gate.
* Own the regulatory and privacy position on the engagement — APRA, MAS, data residency and client\-specific obligations.
* Work shoulder to shoulder with FDEs so trust, evaluation and monitoring capability is built in from the outset.


**Building trust in the people**
* Design the adoption and change approach that builds confidence through transparency, education and demonstrated outcomes.
* Help the client redesign ways of working and human\-agent interaction so the system fits how people actually work.
* Lead enablement so the client's people can and do use what has been built.
* Drive uptake and user confidence after go\-live, tracking active usage rather than reported satisfaction.
* Support executive and Board confidence with clear governance, accountability and decision\-making frameworks.
* Contribute evaluation harnesses, guardrail patterns, governance frameworks and adoption assets to the APAC library.


**KEY MEASURES**
* Governance, guardrails and security controls in place before build starts on every engagement.
* Target accuracy, safety and governance thresholds met and evidenced before production release.
* Adoption above 70% active usage at 90 days post\-go\-live, with effective human\-in\-the\-loop operation.
* Full compliance with Avanade responsible AI standards and client regulatory obligations.
* Reusable trust, evaluation and adoption assets contributed from every engagement.


**Qualifications**
**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 5\+ years across AI governance, model risk, security, responsible AI, or large\-scale technology change and adoption. Strength in two of these with a credible path into the third is expected — few candidates will have all of it.
* Hands\-on evaluation experience with generative or agentic systems is strongly preferred over policy\-only backgrounds.
* Working knowledge of the APAC regulatory environment relevant to their market.
* Practical change and enablement capability with technical audiences and frontline users alike.
* Able to build trust with sceptical stakeholders and to say no with evidence.
* Comfortable in a role that is still being defined, in a track with no established internal precedent.

 Our team handles everything –

 Excited to solve challenges? Join Rapido \& chase bigger milestones too!

**About ZET** 




  





 ZET is building an ecosystem focused on improving access to credit and financial services across Bharat. With a strong presence across underserved markets, ZET connects consumers with trusted financial solutions and makes financial services more accessible.
 



 On our ZET Partner (B2B) platform, we connect communities in Tier 3 and 4 cities to a wide network of financial brands and credit products. By leveraging a trusted network of agents, we bridge the gap between consumers and top banks, making financial services more accessible and tailored to the specific needs of these underserved markets.

title: Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Immigration Specialist
   

  

**Company Description**
 Vialto is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand\-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
   

  

 Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost\-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross\-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.
   

  

 Working at Vialto is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world, and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
   

  

 Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role is focused on assisting with the immigration requirements of our clients' employees. It involves ensuring adherence to Immigration Laws and Regulations and delivering outstanding client service. The caseworker plays a vital role, whether they are assigned to a global account or a specific geographic region. They engage in close collaboration with clients, individual employees, legal teams, government entities, and various stakeholders. This collaboration is essential for facilitating efficient and well\-coordinated immigration processes. The caseworker's responsibilities are crucial in managing the complexities of immigration procedures and ensuring successful outcomes for all parties involved.
   

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for corporate clients seeking immigration support.
* Understand the unique immigration needs of each client and develop tailored immigration plans.
* Handle the end\-to\-end immigration process for employees, including visa applications, work permits.
* Prepare and review immigration forms, petitions, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Interpret and apply immigration rules to ensure clients' compliance and avoid any potential legal issues.
* Advise clients on immigration processes, timelines, and potential risks.
* Maintain accurate and organized case files for each client, ensuring all relevant documents are securely stored and readily accessible.
* Ensure commercial awareness ie efficiently recording time on a timely basis and supporting with billing activities, understanding scope creep.
* Prepare and submit necessary documentation to government agencies and authorities.
* Communicate effectively with clients, government officials, and internal teams to ensure seamless exchange of information.
* Liaise with network office, third party providers, consulates, embassies, and immigration authorities receive up to date immigration rules or monitor case progress and resolve issues.
* Handle unexpected issues that may arise during the immigration (or implementation) process with professionalism and efficiency.
* Provide regular updates to clients on the status of their immigration cases or change to immigration rules.
* Use a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from current trends in business area.
* Address client inquiries, concerns, and feedback in a timely and courteous manner.
* Training new/junior team members on case management and immigration law forms and applications
* Stay up to date with relevant immigration laws, regulations, and policies.
* Depending on the service line you're working in, you might also assist with the implementation of any relevant technology/platform.


**Qualifications**
 Minimum Degree Required: Any Bachelor's degree
   

  

 Minimum Years of Experience: 3\-6 years of experience in providing India Immigration Advice
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Additional Information**
 We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status.
   

  

 Please note, AI is used as part of the application process.

description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
 Global Indirect Procurement
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Job Summary:
   

  

 As Indirect Procurement Sourcing Manager, you will lead commercial procurement activities across multiple spend categories. You will help shape bid strategies, run competitive tendering, perform bid leveling, and negotiate contracts and change orders to deliver best\-value outcomes (cost, schedule, quality, safety, and risk).
   

  

 This position is intended for an experienced procurement professional who can quickly integrate with project teams, manage multiple workstreams in parallel, and drive clear commercial outcomes with suppliers. Success requires strong understanding of commercial construction bidding, capital equipment, professional services, and other related categories.
   

  

 The Sourcing Manager will drive procurement support for various projects across multiple spend categories, as assigned.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 What You’ll Do
   

  

**The Sourcing Manager Will**
* Develop sourcing and tendering strategies for various projects and scopes aligned to project schedule and design maturity.
* Run end\-to\-end competitive bids: develop RFIs/RFPs/RFQs, manage bidder communications, chair bid walks, and ensure clear scope definition and commercial terms.
* Perform bid analysis and leveling (scope, inclusions/exclusions, assumptions, schedule impacts), partnering with design/construction leads or other stakeholders to validate technical alignment.
* Lead commercial negotiations and contracting: pricing structure, payment terms, retention, liquidated damages, insurance, warranties, bonds, and key risk clauses in coordination with Legal.
* Support cost estimating/cost modeling, should\-cost reviews, and value engineering discussions to improve total installed cost while maintaining required standards.
* Drive contract administration support: change order evaluation, claims avoidance, progress payment reviews, and commercial issue resolution.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Construction/Facilities, Engineering/Design, EHS, Finance, and Legal to ensure procurement decisions support safety, quality, schedule, and compliance requirements.
* Track procurement milestones and savings/value metrics (award schedule, cost vs. estimate, change order trends) and provide concise status reporting to project leadership.
* Assess supplier/contractor commercial risk (financial stability, capacity, contract exposure) and recommend mitigation actions.
* Maintain a qualified bidder list and support market intelligence on regional construction conditions, labor/material pricing, and contracting practices.


**Who We’re Looking For**
* Qualifications:
+ Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or related field (or equivalent experience).
+ Experience: 8\+ years in Procurement, supporting categories including capital equipment, precision engineered fixtures, Chemicals and related services. Experience should include procurement/estimating/sourcing, including competitive bidding, costing, and contract negotiation for capital projects. Semiconductor, cleanroom, advanced manufacturing, or lab/critical facilities experience is strongly preferred.


**Skills**
* Strong Category knowledge: bid leveling, scope analysis, pricing structures, and risk/claim awareness, within Indirect Categories including capital equipment, precision engineered fixtures, Chemicals and related services
* Hands\-on contract negotiation and drafting support (e.g., GC/CM agreements, trade contracts, MSAs/SOWs, change orders).
* Strong analytical skills, including cost breakdown review and reconciliation of estimate vs. bid vs. awarded value.
* Tools: Proficiency with Excel\-based bid leveling, cost models, and document control; familiarity with e\-Sourcing/procurement suites and construction contract administration tools is a plus.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Consulting Mindset: Able to ramp quickly, work independently, and deliver outcomes within a defined assignment window.
* Stakeholder Management: Comfortable operating in a matrixed project team and influencing decisions with clear facts and recommendations.
* Attention to Detail: Produces clear bid tabs, negotiation summaries, and award documentation suitable for audit and governance reviews.
* Critical Facilities Exposure: Experience with labs/cleanrooms, high\-purity utilities, or other complex MEP\-intensive projects.
* Process Discipline: Consistently applies structured sourcing, documentation, and approval processes while moving quickly.
* Negotiation Strength: Confident negotiating high\-value construction packages and managing difficult commercial conversations.
* Contracting \& Compliance: Familiarity with standard construction contract terms, insurance/bonding requirements, and basic regulatory/compliance expectations.
* Business Acumen: Balances cost, schedule, and risk tradeoffs; supports leadership with concise options and recommendations.
* Technical or engineering background is a plus

title: People Operations Partner
description:
**Job Summary And Purpose**
 The People Operations Partner provides in\-country\-specific HR operational expertise within the global HR operating model. Acting as the Tier 2 operational HR lead for their assigned country, the role manages complex employee lifecycle activity, local legislative requirements, employee relations support, and operational implementation of HR processes and business change.
   

  

 The role serves as the primary operational HR expert for managers, HRBPs, Payroll, Legal and COEs on country\-specific employment practices, compliance requirements, and operational people matters. The position ensures global HR processes are delivered effectively while remaining compliant with local legislation and market practice.
   

  

 This role is distinct from Global People Services and focuses on judgement\-based operational HR support, local expertise, compliance, and operational execution rather than high\-volume transactional query handling.
   

  

**Main Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Country HR Operations \- Act as the operational HR lead for assigned country populations.
* Manage complex employee lifecycle activity including contractual changes, leave management, transfers, and local compliance processes.
* Ensure operational HR processes are delivered in line with local employment legislation and company standards.
* Support implementation of global HR initiatives within country\-specific legislative and operational frameworks.
* Coordinate with Payroll, Benefits, HRIS, Finance and external vendors to suport compliant local delivery.
* Employee Relations \& Compliance
* Support employee relations matters including disciplinary, grievance, absence, performance, and workplace concerns in partnership with managers and HRBPs.
* Provide practical guidance on local employment legislation, policies, and operational risk.
* Escalate complex or high\-risk matters appropriately to Regional Ops Lead or Legal team.
* Maintain compliance with local labour law, working time obligations, statutory requirements, and internal governance standards.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory documentation requirements.
* Business \& Manager Support
* Provide operational HR guidance to managers on employee lifecycle and country\-specific people matters.
* Support operational delivery of organisational changes, restructures, transfers, and workforce actions.
* Partner with HRBPs to operationalise business decisions and workforce changes.
* Ensure managers are supported through operational implementation of HR processes and policy application.
* Operational Governance \& Improvement
* Identify operational risks, processes, gaps, and opportunities for improvement or standardisation.
* Contribute to development and maintenance of operational process documentation and country guidance.
* Support implementation of new HR systems, operational processes, and service delivery requirements.


**Minimum Education \& Experience**
* Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related field preferred
* Professional HR qualification (e.g. CIPD, SHRM, HRCI or equivalent) desirable.

* Strong HR generalist experience with operational HR ownership

* Strong understanding of local employment legislation and HR operational practices.
* Ability to manage complex operational issues requiring judgement and practical application.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently within a global operating model.
* Strong organisational, prioritisation, and problem\-solving capability.
* Experience working with HR systems and operational workflows.

Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
   

  

 We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise\-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M\&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.

 EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
   

  

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
   

  

 Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
   

  

 Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

 At Goldman Sachs, the mandate of Global Compliance is to prevent, detect and mitigate compliance, regulatory, and reputational risk across the firm and help to strengthen the firm’s culture of compliance. Compliance accomplishes this mandate through the firm’s enterprise\-wide compliance risk management program. As an independent control function and part of the firm’s second line of defense, Compliance assesses the firm’s compliance, regulatory and reputational risk; monitors for compliance with new or amended laws, rules and regulations; designs and implements controls, policies, procedures and training; conducts independent testing; investigates, surveils and monitors for compliance risks and breaches; and leads the firm’s responses to regulatory examinations, audits and inquiries. Compliance provides advice on how to conduct the firm’s business in a manner that complies with the vast array of rules, regulations and regulatory expectations around the globe. Importantly, Compliance plays a key role in reviewing and effectively challenging transactions presenting compliance or reputational risks.

 Compliance provides compliance coverage to the Operations, Engineering, Controllers, Corporate Treasury, Corporate and Workplace Solutions, Executive Office, Corporate Planning Management, Risk, Tax and Human Capital Management divisions.

 You will support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax compliance risks across Amazon’s Global Selling ecosystem. This includes executing operational controls aligned to EU/UK regulatory requirements, maintaining risk documentation, tracking programme deliverables, and escalating emerging risks through appropriate channels. You will monitor regulatory developments and assess their operational implications, contributing analysis that informs programme\-level decisions.
   

  

 Your focus will be on maintaining preventative controls, supporting data integrity across tax and identity systems, and producing audit\-ready documentation. Working cross\-functionally with Legal, Policy, Product, Tax, and Data Science partners, you will execute against programme plans, support the resolution of systemic issues, and contribute to risk\-based control frameworks. You will ensure compliance activities within your workstreams are proportionate, risk\-calibrated, and delivered on time and to the expected quality bar.
